# Acceptance Follow-up Items Only

## Summary
- 结论：用于验证仅有 Follow-up items 的 Acceptance & Validation 不能通过。

## Flow Decision
- `flow_type`: `normal`
- `flow_source`: `user_explicit`

## Goals
- Goal 1: keep acceptance actionable

## Non-goals
- Do not allow follow-up-only acceptance text.

## Task Orchestration
- wave: 1
  - main-agent => implement the demo workflow change (skill: $normal-flow)

## Acceptance & Validation
- Follow-up items

## Assumptions/Defaults
- This fixture intentionally exercises follow-up-only acceptance wording: 已确定
